meta.title: Sequence Diagram — Ambiguity Detector & Clarification Loop
meta.subtitle: Deterministic Comparison Guard, 3-Way Classification, Interactive Clarification, Query Rewrite & Cited Resolution

participants.label: Researcher
participants.explanation: Submits a question, selects an interpretation radio or custom clarification, and reviews resolved citations.

participants.label: Ambiguity UI
participants.explanation: Binds radio/text widgets (amb_interp_radio_*, amb_custom_clar_*) and suppresses repeat clarification prompts.

participants.label: Ambiguity Core
participants.explanation: Checks <2-document comparison regex, classifies questions, rewrites resolved queries, and orchestrates final QA.

participants.label: Chunk Reader
participants.explanation: Scores document chunks against the query and supplies grounded document previews.

participants.label: Gemini Gateway
participants.explanation: Generates AmbiguityClassification, rewritten question string, and cited ResearchAnswer.

participants.label: History DB
participants.explanation: Saves clarified resolution record scoped by user_id after secret sanitization.

segments.label: 3. Query Rewrite, Cited Corpus Answer & Archive

messages.label: retrieve_relevant_chunks(top_k=5) + doc count check
messages.note: Regex guard flags comparison queries as Insufficient Context when len(docs) < 2

messages.label: If unclear: render radio choices & custom input
messages.note: If Clear: skips clarification and proceeds to cited QA

messages.label: Pick interpretation or enter missing context

cards.title: Never Silently Guesses When Context Is Missing
items: Distinguishes Clear, Ambiguous, and Insufficient Context explicitly so under-specified questions pause for user intent rather than hallucinating.
